name: smartkids-store
description: نظام إدارة الطلبات المتقدم لـ Smart Kids Kuwait

scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const lock=fs.existsSync('package-lock.json')?fs.readFileSync('package-lock.json','utf8'):''; const bad=['@otplib/plugin-base32-scure','@scure/base']; const hit=bad.filter(p=>lock.includes('\\"'+p+'\\"')); if(hit.length){ console.error('Blocked dependencies detected in package-lock.json:', hit.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} "

author: Smart Kids Kuwait
